title: Cyclical Entropy Eruption: Entropy Dynamics in Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.27954v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agentic large language models are increasingly used to solve real-world tasks by reasoning over goals, invoking tools, and interacting with external environments. Reinforcement learning provides a natural framework for improving these behaviors, and recent agent RL methods have achieved strong results across domains. However, the training dynamics of agent RL remain poorly understood, limiting our ability to diagnose instabilities and design more effective training algorithms. In this work, we identify a previously underexplored phenomenon in agent RL, which we term cyclical entropy eruption. Unlike single-turn reasoning RL, where entropy typically collapses and stays low, agent RL training exhibits unique recurring cycles of sharp entropy eruption and gradual subsidence. We decompose this dynamic into three phases and provide theoretical and empirical analyses of each, explaining the mechanisms underlying its cyclical oscillation. W

translated_title: 周期性熵爆发：智能体强化学习中的熵动力学
translated_abstract: 智能体大语言模型正越来越多地被用于通过目标推理、调用工具和与外部环境交互来解决现实世界的任务。强化学习为改进这些行为提供了一个自然的框架，近期的智能体RL方法已在多个领域取得了显著成果。然而，智能体RL的训练动态仍然鲜为人知，这限制了我们对不稳定性的诊断能力以及设计更有效训练算法的能力。在本工作中，我们识别了智能体RL中一个此前未被充分探索的现象，我们称之为周期性熵爆发。与单轮推理RL中熵通常坍缩并保持低水平不同，智能体RL训练表现出独特的、反复出现的急剧熵爆发与逐渐消退的循环。我们将这一动态分解为三个阶段，并对每个阶段进行了理论和实证分析，解释了其周期性振荡背后的机制。
tldr: 该论文发现了智能体强化学习训练中一种名为“周期性熵爆发”的新现象——与单轮推理RL中熵坍缩并保持低水平不同，智能体RL的熵会反复经历急剧爆发与逐渐消退的循环，作者将其分解为三个阶段并通过理论与实证分析揭示了其周期性振荡的内在机制。
